about_the_game:
Create the ultimate RPG experience with the second part of the Ultimate RPG SAGA DLC! Inspired by the beautiful music and timeless charm of famous JRPGs, this music pack will let you build memorable adventures for you and your players! Each track was carefully crafted to elevate your game into the shining jewel it was meant to be!

 

Can you guess some of the games which inspired this pack?

 

Content:

 

- 12 tracks  (10 tracks loopable)

 

Track Descriptions:

 

1. Classes and Shapes: A class/character creation theme for crazy makers who can implement such incredible features.

 

2. Overworld: A charming little tune that you can use to travel the overworld of your RPG. Inspired by Ultimate RPG Saga 1 title.

 

3. Quiet Forest: A simple yet really pleasing song for your characters to wander a calm forest or a noble library.

 

4. Town3: What's an RPG without a billion town themes? Here's another one to add to your collection, inspired by the first pack.

 

5. Legends in the Wind: A song for challenging journeys that will surely become part of your heroes' legends.

 

6. Traveller's bag+ Traveller's Flute: A very WPRG-ish theme, with a happy melody at the end.

 

7. Knights of Honour: A theme for marching knights advancing towards their destiny.

 

8. Fall of the Tyrant King: Ideal for storming the demon king's final citadel with nothing but a sword and a bunch of trusty friends.

 

9. Formidable: It was kind of silly of me to make the first music packs with two battle themes but zero boss themes. So, for this music pack boss themes are back with a vengeance!

 

10. Challenge: Another boss theme, less intimidating than the first so that mini-bosses can have some love too.

 

11. Looming Darkness. A dark theme for threatening bosses walking into the scene.

 

12. Sea Hunter: A swashbuckling theme for sailors, rapscallions and scallywags!

 

------

 

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
